# Delta-driven page regeneration

Individual owner pages are regenerated wholesale only when they are marked dirty (either the owner slug or the page slug is in the dirty set); the index and recent-changes pages are always regenerated each run.

Avoid unnecessary regeneration of unchanged pages while ensuring global views (index/recent-changes) reflect the full current state and delta log.
